violated_contract: A hand-written provisioned Grafana query must carry the same sibling objects the datasource's own editor writes, not only the fields the current server version happens to read. Grafana 13's cloud-monitoring migrateRequest treats a promQL target without metricQuery/timeSeriesQuery/timeSeriesList/sloQuery as a legacy metric query, rewrites it without promQLQuery, and the PromQL executor nil-dereferences, so every panel in the /api/ds/query batch returns 500 and paints No data after an otherwise clean Grafana upgrade.
canonical_prevention: Provisioned Cloud Monitoring PromQL targets include a timeSeriesList stub, enforced by a static test over every monitoring and admin dashboard and alert JSON; a Grafana version bump replays one representative provisioned query per datasource type through /api/ds/query before acceptance.
